name: AGIBOT G2 Max
summary: A heavier-payload, force-controlled wheeled task robot for handling and palletising, announced in July 2026 with few published figures.

germany.statusNote: Announced at WAIC 2026 in Shanghai; not on AGIBOT's global site, store or Tekpoint's European list.

notes: AGIBOT gives no payload, size or runtime numbers; it supports battery replacement and autonomous charging.
